# Copilot Instructions

Before exploring the repository, read [docs/CODEMAP.md](../docs/CODEMAP.md) for the project structure, architecture (SwiftUI app + .NET gRPC sidecar), and common workflows. Keep it updated when files or modules are added, moved, or removed.

Task-specific docs:

- UI work (views, sheets, dialogs): [docs/UI-GUIDELINES.md](../docs/UI-GUIDELINES.md)
- Adding or changing gRPC APIs: [docs/PROTO-WORKFLOW.md](../docs/PROTO-WORKFLOW.md) (the two `buskit.proto` copies have drifted; sync before regenerating Swift code)
- Build, test, CI, release commands: [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)
